## Hypothesis

A simultaneous breakdown of the EMA ribbon (8 EMA < 21 EMA < 55 EMA) on elevated volume signals a shift to short‑term bearish momentum. The volume spike confirms institutional participation, increasing the probability of a sustained move lower.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 8‑period EMA crosses below the 21‑period EMA and the 55‑period EMA on a bar, and that bar’s volume exceeds 1.5× the average volume of the prior 20 bars, and the close is below VWAP, enter short at the close.  
Exit: Initial stop placed above the most recent swing high (structure invalidation). Take profit at 1.5× risk or trail with a 12% chandelier stop from the lowest low since entry. Regime filter: only consider entries when VIX > 18 and price is outside the 200‑EMA (trending state); avoid VIX < 12 choppy regimes.
